text: Teaching Objective The major is aimed to train chemical engineers to master the basic knowledge and related knowledge of chemical engineering and technology, the ability of analyzing and solving problems with the knowledge, the ability to adapting the society and international communication skills. Main Course Advanced Mathematics, Inorganic Chemistry, College Physics, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Introduction of Chemical Engineering & Pharmacy, Probability and Statistics, Basic Chemistry(Analysis), Electrical Engineering, Principle of Chemical Engineering, Basis of Chemical Instrument, etc. Internship and Career The school has cooperated with many famous companies including Sinopec Group, China National Petroleum Corporation, China Chemical Group and China Sinochem Group etc. Every school students have the opportunity to make internship in these companies.Sinopec Group Each year the school sends 15-25 students to those appointed company to make practice or graduation project for 1 year. Degree Awarded Bachelor's degree in Engineering School of Chemical Engineering
